text: Rute-Derastold...Two Iss a 1 French Kilogramsome = 229488 lb. devol, Then feel a 1 klator = 20 metres a 209 Brit. fact, five olhs a 3 acreses a 209 Brit. four morgens = 1 lecte force a 24711 kitril. acres. Its liquid on the north and three as 2228 ft2 gallets, the corner makes 128 hectlicite or 5322 Br. busheds.
